CapmCrackaWaka · Nov 28, 2026

This goes back to an old phenomenon I’ve noticed in hiring that’s been around forever. A lot of people want to think they’ve found “the secret” to hiring, and it’s oh so simple! I’ve heard ridiculous versions of this in my life - always 1 liner rules that people think make them sound smart. “If the candidate doesn’t shake my hand, I don’t hire them”. “If they call me by my first name, they’re out”.

Older forms of this exist, like the tale that Henry Ford would invite candidates out to dinner and wouldn’t hire them if they salted their meal before tasting it.

I think what these people are scared of admitting is that hiring is extremely hard, probably the hardest challenge that any company faces, and they’re just as likely to hire duds as anyone else.
